clause_text: Upon execution of this Lease, Tenant shall deposit with Landlord the sum of Two Thousand Dollars ($2,000.00) as a security deposit. Said deposit shall be held by Landlord in a non-interest-bearing account as security for the faithful performance by Tenant of all terms, covenants, and conditions of this Lease. Upon termination of the tenancy, the security deposit, or any balance thereof remaining after lawful deductions, shall be returned to Tenant within thirty (30) days after Tenant has vacated the Premises and surrendered possession to Landlord, together with an itemized written statement of any deductions made therefrom.
key_obligations: pay $2,000 security deposit at lease signing
landlord must return deposit within 30 days of move-out
landlord must provide itemized statement of deductions

clause_text: Tenant shall pay a security deposit equal to one and one-half (1.5) times the monthly rent, currently calculated at Two Thousand Two Hundred Fifty Dollars ($2,250.00). Landlord shall hold said deposit in an interest-bearing escrow account at a federally insured financial institution, and any interest accrued thereon shall be credited to Tenant annually. Deductions from the security deposit shall be limited to unpaid rent, damage beyond normal wear and tear, and cleaning costs if the unit is not returned in broom-clean condition. Landlord shall forfeit the right to any deduction if written notice of claimed damages is not delivered to Tenant within fourteen (14) days of vacating.
key_obligations: pay $2,250 security deposit
landlord holds deposit in interest-bearing account
interest on deposit credited to tenant annually
landlord must deliver written damage notice within 14 days of move-out or forfeits deductions

clause_text: The security deposit of One Thousand Five Hundred Dollars ($1,500.00) shall be held by Landlord. Notwithstanding the foregoing, in the event Tenant exercises the renewal option described in Section 14, the security deposit shall be increased to Two Thousand Dollars ($2,000.00) upon commencement of the renewal term. Tenant agrees that Landlord may apply the deposit against any outstanding balance owed at any time during the tenancy, provided Tenant is given written notice of such application within five (5) business days. Nothing herein shall limit Landlord's right to pursue additional damages in excess of the deposit amount.
key_obligations: pay $1,500 security deposit
deposit increases to $2,000 upon renewal
landlord may apply deposit to outstanding balance during tenancy with 5-day written notice
landlord can pursue damages beyond the deposit amount

clause_text: Tenant shall, at Tenant's sole cost and expense, keep and maintain the Premises and every part thereof in good, clean, and sanitary condition and repair. Tenant shall be responsible for all repairs necessitated by Tenant's misuse, waste, neglect, or negligence, including that of Tenant's family members, guests, and invitees. Tenant shall promptly notify Landlord in writing of any defects or conditions requiring repair. Landlord shall be responsible for maintaining the structural components of the building, including the roof, exterior walls, foundation, and building-wide mechanical and electrical systems serving the Premises.
key_obligations: keep unit clean and in good condition at your own expense
pay for repairs caused by you, your family, or guests
notify landlord in writing of any needed repairs
landlord maintains roof, exterior walls, foundation, and building systems

clause_text: Landlord shall maintain the Premises in a habitable condition as required by applicable law. In the event Tenant reports a habitability defect — including but not limited to failure of heating, plumbing, or electrical systems — Landlord shall commence repairs within seventy-two (72) hours of receipt of written notice for emergency conditions, and within fourteen (14) days for non-emergency conditions. Tenant shall not withhold rent, repair-and-deduct, or abandon the Premises on grounds of disrepair without first providing written notice and a reasonable cure period. If Landlord fails to cure within the applicable period, Tenant's remedies shall be governed by applicable state law.
key_obligations: landlord must keep unit habitable
landlord must begin emergency repairs within 72 hours of written notice
landlord must begin non-emergency repairs within 14 days of written notice
tenant must give written notice and cure period before withholding rent or repair-and-deduct

clause_text: Tenant shall replace, at Tenant's expense, all light bulbs, batteries in smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, and HVAC filters on a regular basis, but no less than every ninety (90) days. Tenant shall not make any alterations, improvements, or additions to the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent. Any permitted alterations shall become the property of Landlord upon termination of the Lease unless Landlord directs Tenant in writing to remove them, in which case Tenant shall restore the Premises to their prior condition at Tenant's sole expense. Unauthorized alterations shall be remediated by Tenant upon demand.
key_obligations: replace light bulbs, detector batteries, and HVAC filters at least every 90 days at your expense
get landlord written consent before any alterations
permitted alterations become landlord property at lease end unless landlord orders removal
tenant pays to restore unit if directed to remove alterations

clause_text: Either party may terminate this Lease upon sixty (60) days prior written notice delivered to the other party. In the event Tenant terminates prior to the expiration of the initial Lease term, Tenant shall be liable for a termination fee equal to two (2) months' rent, in addition to rent owed through the termination date. Landlord shall have a duty to mitigate damages by making reasonable efforts to re-let the Premises, and any rent received from a subsequent tenant during the period covered by the termination fee shall be credited to Tenant's termination fee obligation.
key_obligations: give 60 days written notice to terminate
pay two months rent as early termination fee
landlord must try to re-rent the unit to reduce your termination fee

clause_text: This Lease shall automatically convert to a month-to-month tenancy upon expiration of the initial term unless either party provides written notice of intent not to renew at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration date. Monthly rent during any month-to-month period shall be increased by ten percent (10%) above the last monthly rent paid under the fixed term. Either party may terminate the month-to-month tenancy by providing thirty (30) days written notice. Tenant shall not hold over beyond the notice period without Landlord's express written consent, and any unauthorized holdover shall be treated as a tenancy at sufferance subject to double the monthly rent.
key_obligations: give 30 days notice before lease end to avoid automatic month-to-month conversion
month-to-month rent is 10% higher than final fixed-term rent
unauthorized holdover triggers double rent

clause_text: Tenant may terminate this Lease early without penalty upon thirty (30) days written notice if: (a) Tenant is a member of the United States Armed Forces and receives orders for a permanent change of station or deployment; (b) Tenant suffers a documented disability rendering the unit inaccessible; or (c) Tenant is a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking, as evidenced by a police report or court order. In all qualifying cases, Tenant shall provide supporting documentation with the notice. Landlord shall confirm receipt and release in writing within ten (10) business days. Outside these circumstances, standard early termination provisions apply.
key_obligations: active military orders allow penalty-free early termination with 30 days notice
documented disability or domestic violence also qualifies for penalty-free exit
provide supporting documentation with termination notice
landlord must confirm release in writing within 10 business days

clause_text: Tenant hereby indemnifies, defends, and holds harmless Landlord and Landlord's agents, employees, and successors from and against any and all claims, actions, damages, liability, and expense in connection with loss of life, personal injury, or damage to property arising from or out of any occurrence in, upon, or at the Premises, or the occupancy or use by Tenant of the Premises or any part thereof. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Landlord shall remain liable for damages arising from Landlord's own gross negligence or willful misconduct. This indemnification shall survive termination of the Lease.
key_obligations: you indemnify landlord for claims arising from your use of the unit
landlord remains liable for their own gross negligence or willful misconduct
indemnification obligation survives after lease ends

clause_text: Tenant shall indemnify Landlord for all claims arising from Tenant's use of the Premises. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Landlord shall be responsible for maintaining the Premises in habitable condition pursuant to applicable law. In the event of a conflict between this provision and Section 7 of this Lease, the terms of Section 7 shall control. clause_text: Landlord shall not be liable for any damage or loss to Tenant's personal property caused by fire, theft, water, rain, acts of God, or any other cause, whether due to Landlord's negligence or otherwise, unless such damage is caused by Landlord's gross negligence or willful acts. Tenant is strongly encouraged to obtain and maintain renter's insurance throughout the Lease term in an amount sufficient to cover Tenant's personal property, personal liability, and additional living expenses. Tenant's failure to maintain such insurance shall not relieve Tenant of any obligations under this Lease.

clause_text: No pets of any kind shall be kept on or about the Premises without the prior written consent of Landlord, which consent may be withheld in Landlord's sole and absolute discretion. If consent is granted, Tenant shall pay a non-refundable pet deposit of Two Hundred Fifty Dollars ($250.00) per pet and an additional monthly pet rent of Forty Dollars ($40.00) per pet. Tenant shall be fully liable for any and all damage caused by any approved pet, and such liability shall survive termination of the Lease. Landlord may revoke pet permission upon fourteen (14) days' written notice if the pet creates a nuisance or causes damage to the Premises.

Dogs classified as restricted breeds, including but not limited to Pit Bull Terriers, Rottweilers, and Doberman Pinschers, are strictly prohibited regardless of weight. A refundable pet deposit of Five Hundred Dollars ($500.00) per pet shall be due upon execution of the pet addendum. Pet deposits are subject to the same deduction rules as the general security deposit. No other animals, including reptiles, rodents, or birds, are permitted. Tenant shall ensure pets are licensed and vaccinated as required by local ordinance.
key_obligations: maximum 2 cats or 1 dog under 35 pounds allowed

Landlord shall respond in writing within ten (10) days of receipt. Approval is conditioned upon Tenant's execution of a separate Pet Addendum, payment of the applicable pet deposit, and proof of current vaccinations. clause_text: Rent in the amount of One Thousand Eight Hundred Dollars ($1,800.00) is due and payable on the first (1st) day of each calendar month. Rent received after the fifth (5th) day of the month shall be subject to a late charge of One Hundred Dollars ($100.00). An additional daily late charge of Ten Dollars ($10.00) per day shall accrue for each day rent remains unpaid after the tenth (10th) day of the month. Acceptance of late rent with or without the late charge shall not constitute a waiver of Landlord's right to enforce the late charge provision in subsequent months. Total late fees shall not exceed the maximum permitted by applicable state law.

clause_text: Rent is due on the first of each month and shall be considered late if not received by 5:00 p.m. on the third (3rd) day of the month. A late fee of five percent (5%) of the monthly rent shall be charged for any payment received after said deadline. In addition, Tenant shall be charged a returned check fee of Fifty Dollars ($50.00) for any check returned for insufficient funds or any other reason. Tenant who makes two (2) or more late payments or issues two (2) or more returned checks in any twelve (12) month period may be required by Landlord to pay all future rent via certified funds or electronic transfer only.

This late fee is agreed by the parties to be a reasonable estimate of damages and not a penalty. Partial payments shall not be accepted and shall be returned to Tenant. Landlord's acceptance of partial payment in any month shall not waive the right to demand full payment and shall not create an obligation to accept partial payment in future months.

clause_text: Tenant agrees to conduct themselves and to require all occupants of the Premises and guests to conduct themselves in a manner that will not disturb other tenants' peaceful enjoyment of the building. Quiet hours are in effect between the hours of 10:00 p.m. and 8:00 a.m. Sunday through Thursday, and between 11:00 p.m. and 9:00 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays. Violation of quiet hours, following written notice from Landlord, shall constitute a material breach of this Lease. Tenant shall not play musical instruments, amplified music, or conduct parties in a manner audible beyond the walls of the Premises during quiet hours.

clause_text: Tenant shall maintain the Premises in a clean and orderly manner and shall not permit any waste, nuisance, or unlawful use of the Premises. Tenant shall not smoke tobacco, cannabis, or any other substance anywhere in the building or within twenty-five (25) feet of any building entrance. Tenant shall dispose of all refuse in the designated containers and in accordance with the municipality's recycling requirements. Failure to properly dispose of refuse resulting in a municipal citation shall be the sole financial responsibility of Tenant. Tenant shall not obstruct hallways, stairwells, or common areas with personal property.

Tenant shall be liable for all lost rents and costs incurred by Landlord arising from the unauthorized subletting.
